findings.topic: Rows pin what the frozen camp-01b assertions read
findings.detail: scripts/qc/camp01-authority-receipt.contract.mjs WAVE_CONTRACTS['camp-01b'].assertions = campaignIdMatched, matchIdMatched, revisionMatched, forceMembershipMatched, sourceIdentityMatched, guestMirrorHydrated (verified verbatim by direct read, line 29 of the built DATA object). src/types/campaign/__tests__/CampaignSync.test.ts:415-426 computes: campaignIdMatched (entry.campaignId===CAMPAIGN_ID && guest?.campaignId===CAMPAIGN_ID), forceMembershipMatched (JSON.stringify(hostState.forceUnits)===JSON.stringify(guest?.forceUnits)), sourceIdentityMatched (hostState.rosterUnits['unit-1']?.unitSource==='canonical' && unit?.unitSource==='canonical' && unit?.unitRef==='atlas-as7-d'). The new happy-path row ('projects the roster source identity and force membership...', campaignAuthoritativeState.test.ts:186-224) directly asserts state.campaignId, state.rosterUnits[id].unitRef/.unitSource (both units, including the 'custom' branch CampaignSync's own fixture never exercises), state.forceUnits membership by value, AND Object.keys(state.forceUnits) key order -- a strictly stronger check than CampaignSync's JSON.stringify comparison, since it pins order independent of any host/guest symmetry. matchIdMatched/revisionMatched/guestMirrorHydrated are correctly out of this module's scope (match registration and mirror sync happen at CampaignHostRegistry/CampaignSync, not in the builder) and the new suite does not claim to cover them.
findings.sourceVersionCaveat: sourceVersion is asserted by the new happy-path row (unit-2 gets sourceVersion:4, unit-1 has none and correctly omits the key) but is NOT read by any of the 6 frozen camp-01b assertions -- sourceIdentityMatched checks only .unitSource and .unitRef. The new test file's own doc comment (lines 9-14) is precise about this: it lists only 'campaignId, rosterUnits[id].unitSource / .unitRef, and the exact forceUnits membership map' as what the frozen assertions read, and does not claim sourceVersion is frozen-pinned. This is accurate; sourceVersion coverage here is incidental extra rigor, not a claim that needed verifying against the contract.

buildCampaignAuthoritativeState returns a single object-literal expression that calls projectForceUnits(...) inline as one of the literal's properties; if projectRosterUnits or projectForceUnits throws, the throw propagates before the assignment `projected = buildCampaignAuthoritativeState(...)` in the test helper ever completes, so `projected` stays `undefined` in every guard-throw path by construction (no partial-return branch exists in the source). The evidence's assertionLevelCaveat and the test file's own expectNothingProjected doc comment (lines 91-98) both state this plainly and do not oversell the `toBeUndefined()` check as an independent discriminator -- it is honestly recorded as a restatement of the throw, with the message-matched `toThrow` as the actual killer. No overclaim found.

findings.topic: Future guard-regression gap that would escape all five rows
findings.detail: Mutated line 56 from `if (!unit.unitRef) {` to `if (unit.unitRef === undefined) {` -- a narrowing from a falsy check to a strict-undefined check -- and re-ran the 5-row suite: all 5 passed (no kill). None of the 5 rows ever supplies a catalog reference that is falsy-but-not-undefined (e.g. an empty string ''), so a future regression that narrows this guard to reject only `undefined` (silently admitting `unitRef: ''` or other falsy non-undefined values) would ship undetected by this suite. Mutation was reverted; worktree re-verified clean at c674a5dfc.
findings.severity: LOW -- narrow edge case (empty-string catalog ref), not a shape or membership regression, and orthogonal to the 5 behaviors this slice was scoped to pin (the admission brief's gap was 'no coverage at all', which this slice fully closes for the 5 named behaviors). Does not invalidate any claim made in the reviewed evidence, since the evidence never claims exhaustive mutation-hardness against every possible guard-narrowing -- only that all 5 rows discriminate against the specific M1-M5 campaign, which is independently confirmed accurate.
findings.recommendation: Optional follow-up (not required for this commit): add an empty-string unitRef case to the missing-catalog-reference row, or a dedicated row, if a future slice revisits this file. Not filed as a pending task by this review since it is sub-carve-out (folds inline per the pending-task rubric) and this review has no product-edit mandate.

summary: All five rows independently verified to discriminate exactly as the evidence table claims (M3 and M5 re-run byte-for-byte match). The five rows correctly pin every field the frozen camp-01b assertions read (campaignId, rosterUnits[id].unitSource/.unitRef, forceUnits membership and key order) plus incidental extra rigor (sourceVersion) that the test's own doc comment correctly does not claim as frozen-pinned. The 'nothing projected' caveat is structurally accurate and honestly worded, not oversold. Hygiene is clean: test-only diff, conventional commit subject, no AI attribution, well within caps. One narrow, non-blocking mutation-coverage gap was found and independently confirmed (a falsy-vs-strict-undefined narrowing of the unitRef guard escapes all 5 rows) but does not contradict any claim in the reviewed evidence and does not require an edit to this commit.
